title: Local map config
description: Your own map, on top of the committed layers: map.config.json at the repo root (git-ignored; MAP_CONFIG in .env picks another file). Selects the layers, overrides their source, processing settings and display, adds local-only layers and sets the map's opening view and basemap. The pipeline checks it before it builds anything. ADR 0009; docs/design/02_data_layers_and_popups.md.

$schema.description: Optional, for editors: the path to this schema.

map.description: How the map opens. Written to manifest.json, so the web app reads it; a view in the page URL (#zoom/lat/lon) wins over center and zoom.

enabled.description: The layers to build and show. Default: every layer (committed and local-only).

disabled.description: Layers to leave out (after `enabled`): not built, and hidden from the map if built before.

layerDirs.description: Folders of local-only layer configs, each layer a <name>.env and <name>.style.json like pipeline/layers/. Relative to this file, for example pipeline/layers.local (git-ignored). A name may not repeat a committed layer: use `overrides` to change one.

localLayers.description: Local-only layers defined here, by name: their processing settings (`env`, as in a <name>.env) and display config (`style`, as in a <name>.style.json).

overrides.description: Changes to layers (committed or local-only), by name. `input` and `env` change the tiles: rebuild the layer. The rest changes only its display: `run.sh --style-only` is enough.

layerName.description: A layer name: lower case letters, digits, _ and -.

settings.description: Layer processing settings, as in a <name>.env (see pipeline/lib/config.sh): a LAYER_* name and a text, number or (for an array setting such as LAYER_FIELDS) a list of texts.

input.description: Source data, relative to RAW_DIR (mounted at /data/raw), as LAYER_INPUT. Changes the tiles.

env.description: Other processing settings, added after the layer's .env (for example LAYER_MAX_ZOOM or LAYER_FIELDS). Changes the tiles. Use `input` for the source.

defaultVisible.description: Switched on when the map opens. Display only.

style.description: A JSON merge patch (RFC 7396) on the layer's .style.json: objects merge key by key, anything else (lists included) replaces, null removes a key. title, order and defaultVisible above are applied after it. The result must be a valid display config. Display only.
